title: Decision-OS V12 Minimal Completion Record
description: A minimal structured record for future-restartable closure under Decision-OS V12: Completion Integrity.

as_of.description: Timestamp or As-of marker for when the update was closed, including relevant assumptions, constraints, or capability ceiling when possible.

objective.description: The objective of this update cycle.

what_changed.description: Explicit delta from the prior state.

unresolved.description: Open items, Unknowns, unverified Assumptions, or incomplete structures.

must_preserve.description: Canon, KEEP constraints, definitions, or structures that must not be overwritten or smoothed away.

evidence_anchor.description: Source, log, file, hash, commit, version, URL, or reference that allows future reconnection. Empty values are allowed so DELAY/BLOCK records can expose missing anchors.

restart_point.description: Where the future self should resume. Empty values are allowed so incomplete records can remain inspectable.

stop_condition.description: Conditions that should trigger DELAY or BLOCK instead of continued closure. Empty values are allowed so incomplete records can remain inspectable.

reanchor_condition.description: Conditions under which the update must be re-anchored because the basis has shifted.

next_self_should_not.description: Prohibitions for the future self; what must not be done during continuation.

scope_profile.description: Declared restartability scope for lightweight profile-aware gate behavior.

gate_output.description: Completion Gate output. PASS is not a truth guarantee; it only means the record appears future-restartable under the declared scope.

gate_subtype.description: Optional subtype under the declared gate output. conditional_pass is a PASS subtype, not a fourth gate output.

valid_while.description: Optional condition or period under which the record remains valid.

recheck_by.description: Optional marker for when the record should be rechecked.

responsibility_boundary.description: Optional boundary stating who owns the workflow choice and responsibility.
